next.reason: 1985: 66 data-name-1 RENAMES data-name-2 [ {THROUGH|THRU} data-name-3 ] . with the note that level-number and data-name-1 are not part of the clause. §2023:13.18.45.2 prints the same format and note ("Level-number and data-name-1 are not part of the RENAMES clause"), and §2023:13.16.2 Format 2 (renames) restates it as a data description entry. The 1985 level-2 box marks a module level, not a different requirement. Same programs accepted, same meaning.
